issues.detail: The Greek 'αλληλους ηγουμενοι' (leading one another / ministering to one another) is omitted. The Vietnamese translation simplifies this to a general command to 'consider others better than oneself', missing the active sense of mutual leadership/service.

The Greek 'υπερεχοντας εαυτων' means 'surpassing [others] in excellence' or 'exceeding [others]'. The Vietnamese translation 'coi người khác hơn mình' (consider others better than oneself) reverses the direction of the excellence; the Greek describes the believers' own excellence/superiority in humility, not a subordinate status compared to others.
